episodes.title: When the Plan Stops Working: How Future-Ready Teams Adapt and Move Under Pressure
episodes.description: Why do capable people stop performing under pressure — and why doesn't better planning fix it?

episodes.title: Beyond Strategy, Talent and Hard Work: The Practices That Unlock Performance & Growth
episodes.description: What if your organization doesn't have a talent problem, a strategy problem, or even an effort problem? What if work is hard because of how work actually works?

episodes.title: Employee Behavior is a System Output, Not the Problem
episodes.description: Performance dips. Leadership reacts: a survey goes out, a manager gets replaced, a training gets rolled out. Things improve for a quarter, then the same problems come back wearing different clothes.

episodes.title: The Future of Work Isn't New. We Just Forgot the Basics.
episodes.description: The future of work may not need another shiny new idea. It may need fewer bad meetings, clearer decisions, better access to information, more intentional ways of working, and leaders willing to do the unglamorous work.

episodes.title: Organizational Intelligence Podcast — The OI
episodes.description: A series of real conversations about how work actually works inside modern organizations: how decisions get made, how trust is built or broken, how information flows, and how teams adapt under pressure.
